card.title: Your groups
card.intro: Private chats for your building or street. People join only with an invite.
card.empty: No groups yet. Start one for your building or street, or join with a code a neighbor shared.
card.noArea: Choose your neighborhood to start or join a group there.
card.createsLeft: {count, plural, =0 {You've created 3 groups, the most one person can.} one {You can create # more group.} other {You can create # more groups.}}
card.unreadLabel: {count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}}

create.title: Create a group
create.description: A private chat for one building or street in {area}. You'll be its admin, and neighbors join only with an invite you or another member share.
create.name: Group name
create.nameHint: 3 to 60 characters, such as “Maple Court residents” or “Elm St 1200 block”.
create.created: Group created. Invite your neighbors next.
create.limit: You've created 3 groups, the most one person can.
create.notAllowed: Choose your neighborhood first, then you can start a group there.

join.title: Join a group
join.description: Enter the code a neighbor shared, or paste their invite link.

states.expired: This invite has expired. Ask a member for a new one.
states.revoked: The group's admin turned this invite off. Ask a member for a new one.
states.not_found: We couldn't find that code. Check it and try again.
states.wrong_area: {group} is for neighbors in {area}. You can join groups in your own neighborhood ({yours}).
states.no_area: Choose your neighborhood first: groups are for the people who live there.
states.full: {group} already has 50 members, the most a group can have.

join.privacy: Members see your first name, last initial and neighborhood. Never your address, phone number or email.

group.subtitle: {kind} · {area} · {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}
group.gone: This group isn't available. You may have left it, or the admin removed you.
group.empty: No messages yet. Say hello to your neighbors.
group.blockedHidden: {count, plural, one {# message is hidden because of a block.} other {# messages are hidden because of a block.}}
group.deleteDescription: Everyone in the group sees “Message deleted” instead.
group.masked: Phone numbers, emails and links are hidden in groups. Keep plans and payments on TasksNearMe.
group.cantSend: Your account can't send messages right now.
group.mutedToast: Muted. You won't get notifications from this group.
group.unmutedToast: Notifications are on for this group.
group.leaveDescription: You'll need a new invite to come back.
group.leaveAdmin: You're the admin: the member who joined first after you becomes the admin.
group.leaveLast: You're the last member, so the group closes.

people.title: Members
people.removeDescription: They leave the group and need a new invite to come back.

invites.title: Invite neighbors
invites.intro: Share a link or code. Each works for 7 days, and only for neighbors in {area}.
invites.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it.

previews.adminMembers: Group: the admin's members and invites
